result_text:
The export now looks up the scope file lists by their configured aspect names, so renaming an aspect in `config.json` no longer drops `all_files.zip` or `git-history.zip`. I did not run an end-to-end export with a renamed aspect.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`:
- `all_files.zip` is built from five entries, one per scope aspect in the same order as before. Each entry's name and file contents come from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that writes the loose files.
- I added a small private helper, `getAspectFileEntry`, that does the name lookup and read for one aspect.

With the default config the entry names are unchanged: `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_test.txt`, `aspect_generated.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`, `aspect_other.txt`. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`.

The reports module compiles offline and its tests pass (the module has no tests for the data exporters). Nothing is committed.
